dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular elliptical and 'C' shaped dark perimeters surrounding lighter interior pixels. Most prominent on the upper dorsal-lateral region with sharp transitions between the dark outer ring and the lighter core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-to-moderate density of asymmetrical high-intensity (white/light grey) solid pixel clusters, primarily located on the lower neck and anterior lateral regions, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A roughly isosceles triangular formation visible between the centroids of the three largest macro-annuli located on the mid-dorsal ridge.
